reviewItems.issue: Uploaded PA001 workbook appears blank/zero template.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: Importing zero-value billing would corrupt WIP and A/R views.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Do not import as valid billing/SOV until user provides completed pay app.

reviewItems.issue: Project contract $34,000 vs pay app contract $28,485.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: The app should not force the billing source to overwrite the project contract total.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Store pay-app contract sum separately from app/project contract override; flag for reconciliation.

reviewItems.issue: Prior known forecast/project contract $91,775 vs uploaded pay app contract $79,250.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: Overwriting project contract would misstate backlog and budget.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Store payAppContractSum $79,250; do not overwrite project contract until user confirms.

reviewItems.issue: G702 balance to finish includes retainage; G703 SOV balance is contract minus completed only.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: The summary table and SOV detail will show different balance numbers by design.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Store both Balance To Finish including retainage and SOV Balance C-G; label them clearly.

reviewItems.issue: Previous certificates line and current due do not align in normal G702 math.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: Retainage/final billing may show unusual G702 totals.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Treat as retainage/final closeout billing; flag for review if needed.

reviewItems.issue: Final/current billing appears to be $1,157 for CO005 only.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: G702 current due may need confirmation against CO005 line.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Confirm whether G702 current due should be $1,157.00.

reviewItems.issue: Pay app is essentially a retainage/release billing.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: Completed/stored is already 100%; current due is only $347.87.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Add billing type = Retainage Release / Final Current Due.

reviewItems.issue: G703 displays 0% total due rounding, but calculation is $10,000 / $2,010,000 = about 0.50%.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: The app should calculate precise percent while preserving source display if needed.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Show calculated percent and optional source percent.

reviewItems.issue: Scanned PDF SOV was entered from rendered image, not native text.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: Line-level extraction should be reviewed once inside the app.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Set imported SOV confidence to Medium and require review approval before locking.

reviewItems.issue: Same address area as J230 Whittaker USDC Fitness Center.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: Jobs could be merged incorrectly in imports or dashboards.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Keep J221 Whitaker USMS Vault Door and J230 Whittaker USDC Fitness Center as separate jobs.

reviewItems.issue: Same address area as J221; drive folder link unresolved.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: J232 link may belong to J230 but is unconfirmed.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Keep J230 separate from J221; do not assign drive link until user confirms.

reviewItems.whyItMatters: J227 painting job must not inherit J231 OPM data.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Keep J227 Dole Misc Painting and J231 OPM 2nd Floor as separate jobs.

reviewItems.issue: Customer/GC and exact setup details need confirmation.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: Davis Bacon / tax-exempt job requires correct customer and compliance profile.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Confirm customer BKM/GSA; keep separate from J227.
